items.title: Google Meet integration
items.description: Replace Zoom. Automatically create a Google Meet link when a program is published. Requires Google Cloud project + Calendar API + service account setup first (staff action needed). Full spec in FEATURES.md §19.

items.title: Community onboarding — verify end-to-end
items.description: The full agreedToTerms flow is built: /account/welcome page, proxy intercept, registration form agreements checkbox, login page reframe, cleanup cron. Needs a real end-to-end test run. Delete the test account first to re-trigger the flow.

items.title: Rotate Neon DB password before go-live
items.description: Must be done before DNS cutover. After rotating in Neon console, update POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL and POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING in Vercel environment variables.

items.title: DNS cutover to rim-next
items.description: Point rootedinmindfulness.org to the rim-next Vercel project. Coordinate timing with Webflow handoff. Do DB password rotation first.

items.title: Welcome email after community onboarding
items.description: After a member completes onboarding (agreedToTerms = true), send a warm welcome email via Resend and add them to the Flodesk 'New Member' segment. Applies to both paths: registration form (Path A) and direct login to /account/welcome (Path B). Needs sendWelcomeEmail() in lib/email.ts and Flodesk segment call. Full spec in FEATURES.md §17f.

items.title: Self-service email change
items.description: Member can update their own login email from My Profile. Requires verification email sent to the new address, 3 new DB fields (pendingEmail, pendingEmailToken, pendingEmailExpires), 2 new API routes, email template, and My Profile UI changes.

items.title: Automated dana follow-up cron
items.description: Daily cron sends a gentle nudge email to registrants with donationStatus=PENDING. Needs danaNudgeSentAt on Registration model, a new cron route, and an email template. Triggered by Vercel cron, protected with CRON_SECRET.

items.title: Set course accessLevel in Sanity
items.description: Any course that should require program registration must have Access Level set to 'registration_required' in Sanity Studio → Courses → [course]. Default value 'members' means open to all logged-in users.

items.title: Continue CSS migration (Webflow → design system)
items.description: Continue migrating pages from raw Webflow classes to design-system prefixed classes (pg-, lp-, db-, etc.). See memory/pages-inventory.md for the full page list and migration order. 14/31 pages are currently 🟢.

items.title: Decommission Memberstack
items.description: After members have naturally migrated through participation. Do not bulk-import old members — organic migration is the strategy. Selective import remains possible via /admin/members import tool if ever needed.

items.title: Donation management Phase 2 UI
items.description: Unified donation tracking UI: donor list (searchable, shows giving history), manual cash/check entry form, GiveButter CSV import, filterable donation history, QuickBooks export CSV. The DB schema (Donation model) and Stripe auto-write are already live — this is primarily UI work. Full spec in FEATURES.md §13.

items.title: Rebuild My Library page
items.description: The /account/dashboard-my-library page is currently hardcoded with 4 items that link to the old Webflow site. Should dynamically pull courses available to the member based on their registrations and course access grants, displayed as cards with lesson counts and progress.

items.title: Volunteer interest form — add a backend
items.description: The form at /volunteerism/volunteer has no backend — any submissions go nowhere. Needs an API route to receive form data and email it to staff (or store in DB). The /volunteerism/volunteer-thanks-for-your-interest page is also currently an orphan. Decide: wire up the form or remove both pages.

items.title: Sanity accepted-member revocation — resolve API path
items.description: When a REGISTRAR role is removed, we can cancel pending Sanity invites but cannot remove members who already accepted — all Sanity Management API paths tried return 404. Test with a real non-owner registrar account when one is onboarded. May require a Sanity support ticket. Documented in FEATURES.md §18.

items.title: Audit li/ul margin reset across all content pages
items.description: rim.webflow.css sets li { margin-left: -20px; margin-bottom: 15px } globally. We fixed this for the manual page (man-steps li, man-list li, man-sidebar li). The same issue likely affects rich text bullet lists rendered from Sanity Portable Text on lesson pages (lp-body) and other pages. Audit all pages with lists and add targeted resets.

items.title: Animated botanical elements in program hero
items.description: CSS+SVG botanical drift animation in the pg-hero section. Must include prefers-reduced-motion support. Prompt saved — paste it in a new session to implement.

items.title: Write manual chapters: Member Accounts + Courses & Materials
items.description: The staff manual sidebar lists 'Member Accounts' and 'Courses & Materials' as Coming soon. Member Accounts chapter: looking up members, editing profiles, granting/revoking course access, archived vs active states. Courses & Materials chapter: setting up courses in Sanity, managing access levels, linking programs to courses.

items.title: Email notification preferences
items.description: Members can opt out of certain transactional emails (e.g. reminder emails) from My Profile. Needs emailPreferences Json? on User model, preference checks before each send in lib/email.ts, and a simple UI on My Profile. Full spec in FEATURES.md §17i.

items.title: Member self-service account deletion
items.description: GDPR/CCPA consideration: a member can request deletion of their own account and all associated data from My Profile. Same zero-registration guard as admin delete — if they have registrations, show a message directing them to contact the registrar. Full spec in FEATURES.md §17j.

items.title: Access denied / 401 page
items.description: There is currently no graceful unauthorized error page. When someone accesses a protected route without permission, they see a generic error or silent redirect. Build a warm, RIM-branded 401/403 page that explains what happened and offers a path forward (log in, go home).

items.title: Show drop-in Zoom link on program page for logged-in members
items.description: If a logged-in member is viewing a program page for a recurring drop-in program that has a Zoom link, surface the link directly on the page rather than requiring them to go to the dashboard. Reduces friction for regular attendees. Noted in FEATURES.md §14 as planned but not yet built.

items.title: Member list sorting & saved filtered lists (Planning Center style)
items.description: Upgrade /admin/members with practical sort options (name, join date, last active, registration count, etc.) and a saved filtered list system similar to Planning Center Online. Staff can create and save lists based on criteria like: 'attended drop-in on a specific date', 'completed a specific course', 'joined in the last 30 days', 'has no registrations', etc. Lists are reusable and shareable between admins. Requires research into the right filter fields and UI patterns before building.

items.title: In-person session check-in system
items.description: A fast, easy check-in flow for members attending live sessions at the center. Should work on a phone (member self-check-in via QR code or link) and/or a shared iPad at the door. Needs research into the best UX — options include: QR code per session that opens a check-in page, a kiosk-style iPad app showing the day's registrants with a tap-to-check-in interface, or a hybrid. Should log attendance against the member's record and the program session.

items.title: Exportable PDF check-in sheet for programs
items.description: From the volunteer/registrar view of a program, generate a printable PDF check-in sheet listing registered members with fields for staff to mark attendance. Also useful as a reference sheet for whoever is greeting at the door. Needs research into the right fields (name, registration status, dana status, notes?) and a clean format. Could use a server-side PDF library (e.g. @react-pdf/renderer or puppeteer) or a simple print-optimized HTML page.

items.title: Member participation activity tracking
items.description: Track and categorize member activity over time: website logins, program registrations, session attendance (check-ins), course completions, drop-in participation. Each activity type should be stored with a timestamp and categorized (login / registration / attendance / course / drop-in). Displayed on the member detail page in admin and eventually surfaced in filtered lists and member care context. Requires a new ActivityLog model in Prisma and instrumentation at key touchpoints (login, registration, check-in, course access).

items.title: Member care — important dates & anniversaries
items.description: Staff can record important dates for individual members: birthdays, death anniversaries of loved ones, upcoming surgeries or health events, significant life milestones. Displayed on the member detail page and surfaced in a daily or weekly digest for staff. Long-term: grows into a member care system where different staff or volunteers can contribute, with notes and follow-up reminders. High human value — helps RIM show up as a genuine community, not just a program provider.
